as_of.description: Drop rows anchored strictly after this era or event. (`--as-of`.)

fork.description:
Evaluate under a stored fork's valuation overlay, named by its handle; the
server resolves the handle to the overlay. (`--fork`.)

goal.description:
The goal atom, rendered. The 0.6.3 typed successor is [`Self::goal_atom`];
this string form is a registered field-level killed form, refused from
contract 1.0 and still accepted — and still **required** — before it.

`default` is what lets a 1.0 caller send [`Self::goal_atom`] alone: a
retired field cannot also be a mandatory one. The pre-1.0 requirement is
not dropped, only moved — `serve::required_retired_field` restores it
verbatim on every `0.x` wire.

goal_atom.description:
The goal as a typed atom — the 0.6.3 typed successor to [`Self::goal`],
carried structurally instead of re-parsed from text. When present it is
used and `goal` is ignored; when absent `goal` is parsed exactly as
before. A `Term::Var` argument is a query variable (the string form's
`?who`).

layer.description:
The standing floor for the returned rows (`certain` | `possible` | `all`).
Absent means `all` — no floor. (`--layer`.)

why.description: Attach the support antichain (`--why`) to every row.

AtomExpr.description: A predicate applied to a list of argument terms, e.g. `adjacent(a, b)`.

FileId.description: Identifier for a source file within a compilation.

Ident.description: A named identifier with its source span.

span.description: Where the identifier appears in source.

Layer.description:
The standing floor a query answer is filtered to.

A `Layer` is a **minimum-standing floor** on the answer rows: a row is kept
when its [`Status`] is at least the floor. Because `Status` orders
`Dead < Possible < Certain`, the layers nest — `Certain ⊆ Possible ⊆ All`:

- [`Layer::Certain`] keeps only assertable rows (`Status::Certain`).
- [`Layer::Possible`] keeps the shadow **and** the certain layer
  (`Status::Possible` and `Status::Certain`). Possibility does not exclude
  certainty: a certain claim is a fortiori possible.
- [`Layer::All`] applies no floor — the default.

**Dead atoms never appear in any layer.** A claim whose every monomial is
`Θ`-unsatisfiable is fail-closed-excluded from the evaluated surface
(`02-semantics.md` §3: "excluded from every layer except the error report").
So `Possible` and `All` return the same rows on today's query surface and
differ only in declared intent; surfacing dead atoms is the error report's
job, not a query layer's.

oneOf.description: The shadow layer and the certain layer together.

Span.description: A half-open byte range within a single source file.

file.description: The file this span points into.

Term.description: A term: a variable, symbol, literal, or time reference.

oneOf.description: A ground symbol naming an entity.
A reference into the time domain.

TimeRef.description: A reference to a named era or event on the timeline.
